description.value:
You inscribe a Stored Clone Seal on a scroll, then trigger it with chakra. A semi-substantial clone appears in a square within 30 feet, identical to you, with 25% of your maximum HP. Unlike a Kage Bunshin, this clone cannot cast jutsu, but it has full physical proficiencies and can serve as a decoy or a body double for combat.

The clone lasts 10 minutes or until destroyed. When destroyed, the seal scroll is consumed. The seal itself takes a 10-minute downtime activity (and 1 sp in ink) to prepare.

system.requirements: a prepared Stored Clone Seal scroll (1 sp in ink, 10 minutes)
